bot.name: Automobile Customer Lifecycle Assistant
bot.description: Automation-first automobile assistant covering vehicle discovery, comparison, pricing, brochures, qualified lead capture, test-drive booking, finance and exchange capture, service booking, service status, estimates, payments, and exception-only escalation.
bot.headerTagline: Vehicle discovery, test-drive conversion, and service automation

messages.text: Hi 👋 Welcome to {{dealership_name}}. I can help you find the right vehicle, compare variants, check prices and offers, book a real test drive, schedule service, track service progress, review estimates, and pay the final bill when your vehicle is ready.
What would you like to do?
Tell me what you need. For example: "I need an automatic SUV below ₹18 lakh for family trips." I will capture only the missing details instead of asking a long form upfront.
Share your requirement.
Great. Is the vehicle mainly for city use, highway travel, family trips, or a mix?
Any preference for Petrol, Diesel, CNG, Hybrid, or EV?
Automatic or Manual?
What is the approximate budget ceiling?
When are you planning to buy?
I found close alternatives so you still have strong options even though there was no perfect exact match on every field.
I could not find a maintained live match for that requirement right now. A product advisor can still help with nearby alternatives or incoming stock.
Choose a vehicle by option number or variant ID.\n\n{{vehicle_selection_prompt}}
{{selected_variant_card}}
What would you like next?
For which city should I estimate the on-road price?
{{price_summary}}
What would you like to do next?

{{selected_variant_name}} is currently configured as {{selected_variant_fuel}} / {{selected_variant_transmission}} and is available for enquiry and maintained demo inventory checks. I can continue directly to test-drive booking.
Choose the second variant to compare.\n\n{{compare_variant_prompt}}
{{compare_summary}}\n\n{{compare_variant_name}} is stronger if ADAS and comfort matter. {{selected_variant_name}} is the better value pick if staying tight to budget is the priority.
What next?
{{finance_summary}}

messages: Share the current vehicle details for exchange.

Please enter your mobile number so I can continue with a real test-drive booking.

messages: Share the address for the home test drive.

messages.text: Choose the showroom.\n\n{{showroom_options_text}}

That variant is not available as a maintained demonstrator at the selected showroom right now. A product advisor can suggest the closest alternative immediately.
I do not have a future slot for that showroom and demonstrator right now. Please try another showroom or talk to an advisor for manual recovery.

messages: Choose the test-drive time that works for you.

messages.text: No problem. The test-drive slot has been released.

messages.text: Please verify the registered mobile number for your existing test-drive booking.
Please verify the registered mobile number so I can work with your service booking, estimate, or payment details.

Enter the 6-digit OTP.

messages: I could not find a profile. Share the owner and vehicle details to create a service booking.

messages.text: Choose the vehicle.\n\n{{service_vehicle_options_text}}
I could not find an active vehicle for this customer profile.

Choose the service center.\n\n{{service_center_options_text}}
That service-center selection was invalid. Please restart and choose one of the listed centers.
I do not have a live service slot for that center and service type right now.

No problem. The held service slot has been released.

{{selected_service_order_summary}}

{{selected_estimate_summary}}
How would you like to respond?
The estimate has been marked approved. The workshop can continue without waiting for a callback.

messages: Connecting you to a service advisor with the estimate context.
Please complete the secure payment. I will continue after the gateway verifies the payment status.

channels.message: Payment received for service order {{selected_service_order_id}}. Your vehicle is ready for delivery.

messages.text: Payment received. Your vehicle is ready for delivery or pickup.
Ask your vehicle question.

data.contextTemplate: Use only grounded dealership knowledge for vehicle variants, features, mileage, colors, warranty coverage, offers, finance policies, exchange policy, and service packages. Never invent a feature or confirm stock that is not in maintained records.
data.instructions: Answer conservatively. If the question requires a customer-specific booking, service, or live operational lookup, use the fallback response.
data.fallbackResponseTemplate: I do not have enough verified dealership data to answer that safely without the maintained records.
data.fallbackMessage: I do not have enough verified dealership data to answer that safely without the maintained records.
